summary: Google DeepMind released version 0.0.15 of the dm-haiku library, allowing use without Flax in Python >=3.13 and updating compatibility with the latest JAX release.

practices.reason: A library dependency and compatibility update that developers using Haiku would need to note but which creates minimal work.
practices.quote: Allow using Haiku without Flax in Python >=3.13 (#843).
